title: Descobrindo um novo negócio
message: Hey Dismal-Prune5644, your situation caught my eye — having capital and a tech co-founder but no clear idea is more common than people think. Instead of building from scratch, have you considered acquiring something already running? MicroFlip is a marketplace where you can buy verified micro-SaaS businesses from $500 to $50k. You can browse for free. What kind of software niche would interest you and your partner most?
